title: Validation
purpose: Defines repository validation during repo-spec formation.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall provide one validation entry point.
The validation entry point shall be shell-only and shall not rely on external dependencies.
The validation entry point shall enforce exactly four bootstrap checks: required files, directory separation, relative links, and correct failure exit status.
The validation entry point shall not check formatting, prose quality, Git workflow, hosting-platform behavior, future schema design, product-spec definitions, or source-code behavior.
